data.long_description:
Provident is thrilled to offer this exceptional two ensuite bedroom apartment in the prestigious Barcelo Residences (Al Dar Tower), ideally located in Dubai Marina. Situated on a high floor, this corner unit features stunning canal views along with partial sea vistas, creating a serene and upscale living environment.

The apartment is fully furnished and part of a serviced residence, offering access to premium amenities and a lifestyle of comfort and convenience. A spacious balcony provides the perfect space to relax and enjoy the surrounding views.

Perfectly positioned, the property is just 7 minutes away from Dubai Marina Mall and only a 2-minute walk to JBR — one of Dubai’s most prestigious beachfront destinations — offering direct beach access along with a vibrant selection of restaurants, cafés, and entertainment options.

Ideally located in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront communities, this property presents an excellent opportunity for both end-users and investors.
